style: Calm, precise, technical diagram on a transparent background (house set: Remotion secrets-safety videos). Dark navy cards, brand indigo structure, rose = leaked, mint = held. Builds, never sizzles.
font: Inter (400-800) + JetBrains Mono (400/500/700), local woff2 in assets/fonts/
brief: Three horizontal lanes ('doors') run from a secrets card (.env holding the rose canary CANARY_ENV_7f3a9c, plus the env var APP_API_TOKEN) to a 'Claude's context' card. Rose canary packets flow through all three lanes and each lane's context slot reads LEAKED; the context card tints rose. One mint gate per lane then snaps shut in turn: permissions.deny Read(...) on Claude's file tools (Read .env, cat .env), sandbox.filesystem.denyRead on any shell command (python script.py, grep -r .), and, after a pattern interrupt that isolates the still-leaking environment lane ('the door nobody closes'), sandbox.credentials on environment variables (printenv, env). Packets that reach a closed gate stop and fade; the slot flips to HELD. The piece ends calm and indigo on 'You need all three.' with all three layer names readable. Dominant motif: gates snapping shut, one per lane.

content.source: docs/setup/secrets-safety.mdx, The Results table + The Minimal Config

scenes.caption: Layer 1: deny rules stop the Read tool and cat.
Layer 2: the sandbox stops every shell command.
The environment: the door nobody closes.

content.motion: Entrances power3.out, lanes stagger 100 ms; packets linear (ease none) at 400 px/s, deterministic schedule (period 1.0 s, lane offsets 0.5/0.7/0.9 s), gate times chosen so no packet straddles a gate as it drops; gates scaleY 0->1 with back.out(1.6) in 0.25 s; blocked packets fade at the gate with a mint gate flash; last motion ends ~9.4 s, static hold to 11.5 s.
